title: 'Everything is a file' bent Unix toward uniformity
body: Treating devices, and later processes and sockets, as files let one set of operations, open, read, write, close, work on wildly different things. Linux's /proc turned even kernel state into readable files, scriptable with cat. The abstraction leaks, but seventy years of tooling reuse says the bargain was worth it.
